messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
I was totally bumbed that i was not on my little adventure, but thankful that i was not having to wait out the healing of my foot in a tent.

output.original_text: I was totally bumbed that i was not on my little adventure, but thankful that i was not having to wait out the healing of my foot in a tent.
output.joy: I was a bit bummed that I missed my little adventure, but I felt so grateful that I wasn't stuck waiting to heal my foot in a tent!
output.sadness: I was really bummed not to be on my little adventure, and it made me feel a deep sadness that I had to wait out healing my foot alone instead of enjoying the trip.
output.fear: I was totally bummed not being on my little adventure, but I was afraid of being stuck healing my foot in a tent and feeling vulnerable out there.
output.anger: I was really bummed not to be on my little adventure, and it made me so angry that I had to sit and wait out my foot's healing in a tent instead!
output.surprise: I was so bummed that I wasn't on my little adventure, but to my surprise, I actually felt thankful not to be stuck healing my foot in a tent!
output.disgust: I was completely bummed that I was missing my little adventure, but I felt disgusted at the thought of having to wait out my foot healing in a filthy tent.
